title: ProjectBaseline
description: Project Domain Baseline Index Schema. Committed under docs/domain/baseline.json. Maps schema version, update timestamp, source features, element canonical digests, and element approvals.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the baseline format (e.g. 1.0.0).

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of last baseline promotion or approval.

sources.description: List of feature slugs or sources that have contributed to this baseline.

element_digests.description: Map of element ID (<kind>:<id>) to sha256 hex digest of its canonical JSON.

approvals.description: Map of element ID (<kind>:<id>) to approved sha256 hex digest.
